prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a native Android app, portrait 9:16
Primary request: Design Composition C for Pharma Auto as an evidence-versus-confirmed Material 3 review table. Structure in order: edge-to-edge status/top app bar taking 8% height; line pager and item identity taking 12%; a source-evidence strip taking 13%; a four-row comparison table taking 42%, where the left column is read-only OCR source and the right column is the editable confirmed value; live calculation and policy summary taking 13%; fixed save action taking the remainder. The four rows are Purchase unit price, Discount 1, Discount 2, and Selling price per box. Make change provenance and corrected values the focal hierarchy.
Style/medium: impeccable conventional Material 3, light theme, white ground, pale gray read-only source column, very pale green confirmed column, deep forest green primary and focus outline, amber only for uncertain source evidence, clean Android system typography, 48dp row targets, modest 8-12dp corners, standard icons and dividers.
Composition/framing: one full portrait app screen, no device frame. A previous/next line pager is familiar and compact. The comparison table is attached to the page, not styled like a spreadsheet clone. Leave space for Arabic labels and RTL mirroring, no keyboard.
Text/data: "Pharma Auto", "Review commercial values", "Line 1 of 8", "Synthetic example", "Item 60495", "Quantity 2 boxes", "OCR source", "Confirmed", "Purchase unit price", "EGP 100.00", "Discount 1", "10%", "Discount 2", "5%", "Selling price per box", "EGP 150.00", "After Discount 1 EGP 90.00", "Net subtotal EGP 171.00", "Tax included", "New stock only", "Old stock preserved", "Save review revision", "No Genius write".
Constraints: use EGP only; exactly four editable confirmed-value regions; preserve the source evidence as read-only; explicitly communicate immutable review and no old-stock repricing. No product name, supplier/customer, testimonial, real invoice, date, logo, or claim. No watermark.
Avoid: dense tiny spreadsheet, excessive cards, decorative pills, gradients, glassmorphism, pharmacy cross, global repricing language, hidden calculation sequence.
